subject: Logic
title: Thomson's Lamp
description: A fast breakdown of Thomson's Lamp for builders.

hook.text: Flip a lamp on after one minute, off after half a minute, on after a quarter. After two minutes—on or off?

buildup.text: Thomson's lamp performs infinitely many switches in finite time. The total is two minutes exactly.

discovery.text: The series 1 + 1/2 + 1/4 + ... converges to 2. All switches complete. But what's the final state?

twist.text: There is no last switch—infinity has no final step. The question itself might be meaningless.

climax.text: The paradox shows that completing infinite tasks doesn't always leave a definable result.

punchline.text: No last step means no final answer.

quiz.question: What makes Thomson's lamp paradoxical?
options: Infinite switches leave no definable final state
